senses.gloss:
लख् लख् or लङ्ख् (= rt. लिङ्ख्), cl. 1.
P. लखति, लङ्खति, &c., to go, move,
approach.

लाख् लाख् (= rt. राख्), cl. 1. P. लाखति,
&c., to grow dry, be dry or arid; to
adorn; to suffice, be competent; to prevent.

लखिमादेवी लखिमा-देवी, f., N. of a prin-
cess, (a corruption fr. लक्ष्मी-देवी.)
